column1: # Seconds per mutant on a ubuntu-24.04 runner (4 workers), for the shard
# balance of the full run only. A key is a package directory, one file of it
# (dir/file.go) or one mutator of one file (dir/file.go:MUTATOR); a mutant
# costs the row of its mutator in its file, else of its file, else of its
# mutgate refuses a key that names no package, in-scope file or mutant of
# The rows are the units of the full run 45751491495 (2026-11-26, the
# 64-unit plan of 20 shards): each unit's Gremlins elapsed time over its
# mutants, every (file, mutator) of the unit at that rate. A unit that run
# did not finish (shards 5, 11 and 17) was run locally (8 workers, macOS
# arm64). Its places mutants are priced per file and mutator from their
# local status by the fit of the 36 places units of that run: 1.41 s a
# killed and 8.91 s a lived mutant, and at least 600 s for a file's
# mutator with a mutant that timed out (unit places.23 took 618 s on the
# runner for one; since #255 the tests kill those, and the three rows are
# re-measured from local runs with the loop deadlines). Another package's unit is its local time times 3.7
# (units places.37, places.10, limits and number: 453 s on the runner, 123
# to 126 s locally). The cost varies by file and mutator: a mutant that
# lives runs all of its package's tests (about 9 s on the
# runner in places), one killed stops at the first failing test (about
# 1.4 s), and one that never ends costs Gremlins' timeout, the coverage run
# times --timeout-coefficient (about 600 s in places). Re-measure after a
# release run whose shards drift from the estimate.
